text:
Sam: Hey team — Acme POC just landed. They returned an order form but want us to countersign only after they receive proof-of-funds (bank letter). Also they pasted a handful of MSA/DPA redlines into the OF. Can legal + finance advise quick?
Aisha: quick read — they removed our limitation of liability and added a strict 45d termination notice. They also asked to host EU-only. I flagged the MSA/DPA redline that tries to require state-law indemnities.
Ben: For proof-of-funds we can accept either a bank letter or a corporate credit line confirmation. Finance prefers PO + signed OF; net45 is non-standard for this account but possible with approval. How much are they committing?
Sam: Order form summary snippet (from their doc):
```
Total committed: $150,000/yr
Billing: Net45
Data residency: EU-only
Signature flow requested: Acme countersign -> Redwood countersign -> Proof-of-funds before countersign
```
Clare: On the POC side — they asked for dedicated capacity with VPC + KMS. We already have a security questionnaire outstanding (they marked several items as blockers). If legal wants to concede EU-only we should ensure Private deployment or dedicated region routing.
Aisha: My take — we can accept EU residency via DPA Annex + Service Addendum referencing region pinning. We cannot concede unlimited liability; need to restore our cap and carve outs. As for the signature flow: standard is customer signs then we countersign. If their procurement insists we countersign first, we need Director Legal sign-off.
Jordan: For e-sign routing I can send a DocuSign envelope with conditional attachments (bank letter + order form). If they require countersign before proof-of-funds, we can mark that as an exception but it must be approved by Legal + Finance. Wet-ink will add 3-5 business days.
Ben: I can approve Net45 for this deal up to $200k ARR with a finance approval note. If they need earlier counter-sign, we'd want a short escrow or partial payment up-front.
Sam: They asked for a same-day turnaround. Can we realistically get legal + finance sign-off by EOD? If not, tell procurement to accept temporary PO + conditional countersign after bank letter.
Aisha: I'll push a redline that keeps EU residency via DPA annex and restores our liability cap. If they still require us to countersign first, I'm looping in @DirLegal — please stand by.
Clare: Technical note — if we accept EU-only, ops will need a dedicated placement and KMS key config. That adds provisioning time (~2 business days) after countersign.
LegalBot: DocuSign envelope created: envelope_id=ENV-88234 — waiting on Acme signature.
Sam: OK thanks. @Ben can you confirm finance approval path? @Aisha please post the redline summary here when ready and I'll update Acme procurement with conditional PO option. :thumbsup:
